title: Trace Boundary
text: Trace object boundaries in binary images, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Initial search direction} sets Type of initial search direction; {Connectivity} sets the type of pixel connectivity, {Trace direction} sets the boundary trace direction and {Maximum number of boundary pixels}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Start Pt
ports.summary: Coordinate of boundary starting point two-element vector

ports.name: Pts
ports.summary: Coordinates of boundary points M -by-2 matrix

params.name: Initial search direction
params.values: Type of initial search direction North (default) | East | South | West | Northeast |...

params.name: Maximum number of boundary pixels
params.values: Maximum number of boundary pixels 500 (default) | scalar
